page.overview:
Who is Dr. Hundtkinder?

He first appears when Major Bludd brings the Baroness to him to perform reconstructive surgery on her.

Some time later, Scarlett takes Snake-Eyes to Dr. Hundtkinder in order to repair his damaged face, but after they give Hundtkinder the photo of Snake-Eyes' old face, he sends it to the Baroness . Luckily, Hawk calls Scarlett to tell her that Zarana revealed Hundtkinder's complicity with the Baroness, so Scarlett kicks into the operating room and takes the just-reconstructed (and sedated) Snake-Eyes away from Hundtkinder.
